binary_search.optimal:
left = 0, right = n - 1
while left <= right:   (if target exists it is inside [left, right])
    mid = (left + right) / 2
    if nums[mid] == target: return mid
    if nums[mid] < target: left = mid + 1
    else: right = mid - 1
return -1

search_insert_position.optimal:
left = 0, right = n - 1, answer = n
while left <= right:
    mid = (left + right) / 2
    if nums[mid] >= target:
        answer = mid   (mid qualifies; look further left for an earlier one)
        right = mid - 1
    else: left = mid + 1
return answer

find_first_and_last_position.optimal:
first_index_at_least(nums, value):   (first index whose element is >= value, or n)
    left = 0, right = n
    while left < right:
        mid = (left + right) / 2
        if nums[mid] < value: left = mid + 1
        else: right = mid
    return left
first = first_index_at_least(nums, target)
if first == n or nums[first] != target: return [-1, -1]
last = first_index_at_least(nums, target + 1) - 1
return [first, last]

search_2d_matrix.optimal:
if the matrix is empty: return false
rows = row count, cols = column count
left = 0, right = rows * cols - 1   (positions in the rows laid end to end)
while left <= right:
    mid = (left + right) / 2
    row = mid / cols, col = mid mod cols
    value = matrix[row][col]
    if value == target: return true
    if value < target: left = mid + 1
    else: right = mid - 1
return false

find_min_rotated_sorted_array.brute:
best = nums[0]
for each value in nums:
    if value < best: best = value

search_rotated_sorted_array.optimal:
left = 0, right = n - 1
while left <= right:
    mid = (left + right) / 2
    if nums[mid] == target: return mid
    if nums[left] <= nums[mid]:   (left half [left, mid] is sorted)
        if nums[left] <= target and target < nums[mid]: right = mid - 1
        else: left = mid + 1
    else:   (right half [mid, right] is sorted)
        if nums[mid] < target and target <= nums[right]: left = mid + 1
        else: right = mid - 1
return -1

loop:

koko_eating_bananas.optimal:
hours_needed(piles, speed):
    hours = 0
    for each pile in piles: hours += pile / speed rounded up
    return hours
left = 1, right = max pile
while left < right:
    mid = (left + right) / 2
    if hours_needed(piles, mid) <= h: right = mid   (fast enough: try slower)
    else: left = mid + 1
return left

reverse_linked_list.optimal:
prev = null, cur = head
while cur is not null:
    nxt = cur.next   (save the rest before breaking the link)
    cur.next = prev
    prev = cur
    cur = nxt
return prev

while node is not null: append node.val to values, node = node.next

merge_two_sorted_lists.optimal:
dummy = new node, tail = dummy
while list1 and list2 are both not null:
    if list1.val <= list2.val:
        tail.next = list1   (hook the smaller front node onto the result)
        list1 = list1.next
    else:
        tail.next = list2
        list2 = list2.next
    tail = tail.next
if list1 is not null: tail.next = list1
else: tail.next = list2
return dummy.next

add_two_numbers.optimal:
dummy = new node, tail = dummy, carry = 0
while l1 or l2 is not null, or carry != 0:   (a final carry adds a digit)
    total = carry
    if l1 is not null: total += l1.val, l1 = l1.next
    if l2 is not null: total += l2.val, l2 = l2.next
    carry = total / 10
    digit = total mod 10
    tail.next = new node(digit)
    tail = tail.next
return dummy.next

remove_nth_from_end.optimal:
dummy = new node pointing at head
slow = dummy, fast = dummy
advance fast n + 1 times   (open a gap of n + 1 links)
while fast is not null:
    slow = slow.next
    fast = fast.next
slow.next = slow.next.next
return dummy.next

    if node is in seen: return node   (the first node reached twice starts the cycle)
    add node to seen
    node = node.next

linked_list_cycle_ii.optimal:
slow = head, fast = head
while fast and fast.next are not null:
    slow = slow.next
    fast = fast.next.next
    if slow is fast: stop   (they met: there is a cycle)
if fast or fast.next is null: return null
pointer = head
while pointer is not slow:   (head and meeting point are equally far from the entrance)
    pointer = pointer.next
    slow = slow.next
return pointer

intersection_of_two_linked_lists.optimal:
list_length(head) = number of nodes in the list
len_a = list_length(head_a), len_b = list_length(head_b)
a = head_a, b = head_b
advance a (len_a - len_b) times   (only when A is longer)
advance b (len_b - len_a) times   (only when B is longer)
while a is not b:   (both are now the same distance from the end)
    a = a.next
    b = b.next
return a

palindrome_linked_list.optimal:
slow = head, fast = head
while fast and fast.next are not null:   (slow lands on the middle)
    slow = slow.next
    fast = fast.next.next
prev = null, cur = slow
while cur is not null:   (reverse from the middle onwards)
    nxt = cur.next, cur.next = prev
    prev = cur, cur = nxt
first = head, second = prev
while second is not null:   (the reversed half is the shorter one)
    if first.val != second.val: return false
    first = first.next, second = second.next
return true

copy_list_with_random_pointer.brute:
position_of(head, target) = steps from head to target
node_at(head, steps) = the node that many steps after head
dummy = new node, tail = dummy, node = head
while node is not null:   (pass 1: copy values and next pointers only)
    tail.next = new node(node.val)
    tail = tail.next, node = node.next
node = head, clone = dummy.next
while node is not null:   (pass 2: random = the clone at the same position)
    if node.random is not null:
        steps = position_of(head, node.random)
        clone.random = node_at(dummy.next, steps)
    node = node.next, clone = clone.next
return dummy.next
copy_list_with_random_pointer.optimal:
if head is null: return null
node = head
while node is not null:   (pass 1: A -> A' -> B -> B' -> ...)
    clone = new node(node.val) with next = node.next, node.next = clone, node = clone.next
node = head
while node is not null:   (pass 2: the clone of X.random is X.random.next)
    if node.random is not null: node.next.random = node.random.next
    node = node.next.next
node = head, new_head = head.next
while node is not null:   (pass 3: unweave the two lists again)
    clone = node.next, node.next = clone.next
    if clone.next is not null: clone.next = clone.next.next
    node = node.next
return new_head
